instructions:
SoundCraft is a digital audio workstation (Pro Tools-class). Everything a user can do is a command: call `list_commands` to discover ids and their params, then `execute` (or `batch`). Positions are samples (integers), `{"seconds": x}`, or time strings like "bars_beats:5|1|000" / "0:12.500". Tracks are referenced by id or name. Verify your work with `inspect_session` (tracks, clips, mixer, automation, markers, selection). Programmatic calls never open dialogs. Tools marked APP_ONLY need the desktop app (`soundcraft --control 0` + `soundcraft-cli mcp --connect PORT`).
Backend: headless engine, session `Untitled`.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run several commands in order; stops at the first error unless keep_going.

tools.name: bounce_mix
tools.description: Render the mix to an audio file. Returns peak dBFS and integrated LUFS.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: APP_ONLY. Drag with the primary button.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run one command by id with JSON params. Returns the command's result.

tools.name: import_audio
tools.description: Import an audio file (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, OGG, AAC/M4A, ALAC, CAF) onto a new or existing track.

tools.name: inspect_session
tools.description: The whole session as JSON: tracks (clips, inserts, sends, automation), busses, markers, groups, selection, transport.

tools.name: key
tools.description: APP_ONLY. Press a key with modifiers.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: List SoundCraft commands (id, label, menu path, shortcut, params doc, enabled).

tools.name: menu_invoke
tools.description: APP_ONLY. Invoke a menu item like a click (may open its dialog), e.g. "Track > New...".

tools.name: new_session
tools.description: Start a new session (optionally the built-in demo).

tools.name: parity
tools.description: Feature-parity report against the incumbent's menu catalog.

tools.name: save_session
tools.description: Save the session (path required the first time; replace: true to save over another existing file).

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: APP_ONLY. UI state: front window, panels, layout rectangles of tracks, dialogs.

tools.name: ui_set
tools.description: APP_ONLY. Set UI state fields, e.g. {"window": "Mix"}.
